title: The derivation problem, answered by segmentation

statements.text: Cosmopsychism owes an account of how individual consciousnesses are derived from cosmic consciousness. A visual experience is a unity more fundamental than its color and regional segments, and cosmic consciousness may unify individual consciousnesses the same way. Schaffer’s accounts of how a basic cosmos is heterogeneous, by distributional properties, regionalized properties or regionalized instantiation, can be adapted to cosmic consciousness.

sources.quote: How could medium-size individual consciousnesses be derived from the cosmic consciousness?
Perhaps the cosmic consciousness unifies individual consciousnesses in a similar way.
